neighbours.label: the word 'shake' and its forms (shake, shakes, shook, shaken)
fire: Before serving, remember to shake the bottle well.
The old man's hands began to shake in the cold.
When they met, the two leaders shook hands for the cameras.
Everyone was badly shaken by the news of the accident.
The earthquake shook buildings across the whole valley.
She makes a protein shake every morning after her run.
He tried to shake off the feeling that someone was watching.
The dog shakes water from its coat after every swim.
